facts.fact: The conference proceeding titled 'Diamond photonic crystal slab: Leaky modes and modified photoluminescence emission of surface-deposited quantum dots' was published on December 3, 2012.
The conference proceeding titled 'Efficient light coupling for optically excited high-density metallic nanotip arrays' was also published on December 3, 2012.
